spec: §14.8 (owner Q1b group: items 18 empty-repo-sizing, 19 zero-session-share, 20 submission-identity)
summary: Report robustness: work-scope close --repo "" no longer silently skips sizing (R11), a zero-session group renders no NaN% share (R12), and an incomplete export segment renders no `undefined` or $null in submission.md (R18).

fault-batch-cost-empty-repo.reason: work-scope close --repo "" is now a usage error naming --repo (exit 1) instead of silently skipping sizing (item 18).

cov-team-report-batches.reason: A zero-session group renders a dash for its token shares instead of NaN% in the batch tokenomics views (item 19).

cov-export-submission-edges.reason: An incomplete segment drops the missing stop and owner from the title and identity row, and an overflowing cost sum renders n/a, never undefined or $null (item 20).

cov-work-scope-close-faults.reason: The close faults leave zero-session groups whose batch-tokenomics.md printed NaN% token shares; they now render a dash (item 19).

fault-gate-fold-symlink.reason: The folded-gate group has no captured session, so its batch-tokenomics.md printed NaN% token shares; they now render a dash (item 19).
